text:
sara: Idea 1 1 : run a short SI enablement sprint that bundles (1) marketplace listing template, (2) cloud credits for test runs, (3) lightweight hardware validation checklist. target: get 5 partners through in 6 weeks.

ben: +1. we should map which SIs already have marketplace experience vs new ones. co-marketing ask?

lia: for the cert side: propose a two-tier badge  'Verified Integrator' (passes deploy+load test) and 'Verified Plus' (passes security checklist + case study). keep issuance automated.

tom: ops note : we can stand up short-lived cloud accounts with quotas and default SSH keys. shipping vendor kits is slower; prefer cloud-first for MVP.

jamie: recommend one onboarding lab per SI: 1hr walkthrough + 2hr hands-on in their sandbox. then 1-week follow-up for tuning help.

partners-bot: Added checklist items: [marketplace metadata, cloud credit allocations, sandbox creds, hardware-BOM (opt), cert-rubrics] to /partnerships/si-enable-tracker.

lia: automation idea: when SI completes demo, generate a GitHub PR to a public repo that adds their badge + short partner blurb. PR template: why, what was validated, contact.

legal-bot: Heads-up: need marketplace terms approval before logo/live listing. minimal reqs: partner MSA, logo usage grant, data-processing clause. I'll add required doc list.

ben: co-marketing: keep first wave "no press" but prepare a joint case-study kit (email copy, one-pager, short video brief). aim for case study after 1 customer rollout.

sara: operational items: 1) ben: inventory SIs + tag marketplace experience (due Mon) 2) tom: propose cloud credit SKU + provisioning flow (due Wed) 3) lia: draft badge criteria + cert email template (due Thu) 4) jamie: sample lab schedule + lab exercises (due Fri)

tom: provisioning snippet (CLI) below for sandbox accounts:
```
redwoodctl accounts create --type sandbox --quota "cpu=32,gpu=2,storage=200GB" --expires 14d --owner "si@example.com"
```

jamie: lab exercise idea: deploy model from catalog -> enable prefix cache -> run 5-minute burst at 100 rps -> capture p50/p95 and token-cost dashboard. include troubleshooting steps.

lia: badge names: ["Redwood Integrator", "Redwood Integrator + Compliance"]. small SVG badge + Markdown snippet to display on partner site.

ben: who owns the marketplace listing copy? marketing + partner SEs. I can draft initial template.

sara: ok let's run pilot with 3 SIs: one cloud-native, one with HW, one MSP. schedule kickoff invites this week. next check-in Fri EOD in this thread. thanks! :rocket:
